data.code:
query Permissions($currentPage: Int = 1, $perPage: Int = 10, $sort: [PermissionSortType!], $search: String, $filter: PermissionFilterType, $rand: Boolean = false) {
  permissions(current_page: $currentPage, per_page: $perPage, sort: $sort, q: $search, filter: $filter, rand: $rand) {
    data {
      id
      name
      action
      module
      scope
      isDelete
      weight
      state
      deletedBy
      updatedBy
      createdBy
      deletedAt
      updatedAt
      createdAt
      roles {
        ...OperatorRolesFields
      }
      
    }
    current_page
    per_page
    total
    total_page
  }
}
